text: Bank of Baroda's India deposits grew faster than its India loans. Canara Bank did the opposite.
Clue one. Canara's loans in India grew seventeen percent. Its deposits in India grew eleven. Loans outran deposits by twenty nine thousand crore.
Clue two. P N B's overseas loans grew sixty three percent.
The twist. P N B now lends a hundred and twenty nine rupees abroad for every hundred it holds there. A year ago, ninety seven.
Two banks, two different gaps. How will they fill them? Back to the napkin.
